title: Sharing manifests, recipient permissions, notifications, and delivery
objective: Deliver immutable media versions to explicit recipients with enforceable permissions and durable delivery evidence.

obligations.title: Public links are private, immutable, permission-enforced, revocable, and usable on mobile and desktop
obligations.residualRisk: A public or mutable link can expose original media or change beneath a client decision.

obligations.title: Recipient fan-out is authorized, queued, signed, idempotent, retryable, and observable
obligations.residualRisk: Direct outbound calls can be forged, duplicated, silently lost, or used to reach private infrastructure.

obligations.title: Every grant, view, download, message, decision, expiry, and revocation is governed and auditable
obligations.residualRisk: Incomplete delivery records cannot prove who received or accessed a commissioned asset.
